verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an ecommerce platform, since self-hostable alternatives exist in this category, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows only a hosted SaaS backend accessed via APIs, with Stencil described as a theme engine for 'hosted storefronts' and headless options (Catalyst, GraphQL Storefront API) covering only the frontend layer. The community mention of running the site locally refers to theme development against live hosted data, not self-hosting the core commerce platform.
